title: Director of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Sr. Workday Financials Consultant
description:
Senior Workday Financials Consultant

About the Role

Aspire is looking for a Senior Workday Financials Consultant to join our Finance Solution Delivery team on a contract basis.

In this role, you will serve as a versatile Workday Financials subject matter expert, supporting production operations, system enhancements, and strategic Finance transformation initiatives.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the Workday Financials platform remains stable, scalable, and continuously optimized.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Workday Financials professional who can work independently, solve complex problems, and provide hands-on expertise across multiple Financials domains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on configuration, administration, and production support across Workday Financials.
  • Troubleshoot system issues, investigate defects, and provide timely and effective resolutions.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions.
  • Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities.
  • Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health.
  • Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements.
  • Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment with stakeholders across U.S. time zones.

Required Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of hands-on Workday Financials experience.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end financial processes within Workday.
  • Proven experience supporting both production environments and project-based initiatives.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and systems-thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday Financials domains.

Priority Workday Financials Areas

Highest Priority

  • Financial Accounting
  • Expenses
  • Business Assets

Secondary Priority

  • Banking & Settlement

Nice to Have

  • VNDLY experience

Lower Priority

  • Procurement experience — the organization is gradually phasing this area out.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means you:

  • Seamlessly support multiple Workday Financials domains based on business priorities.
  • Reduce the production support backlog and improve responsiveness to Finance stakeholders.
  • Deliver scalable, maintainable solutions rather than short-term fixes.
  • Resolve issues efficiently while minimizing business disruption.
  • Become a trusted extension of the core Workday team.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and long-term Finance transformation initiatives.

Why Aspire?

  • Join a Remote-First organization.
  • Work alongside exceptional technology professionals from around the world.
  • Access continuous technical and professional development opportunities.
  • Gain international exposure by collaborating with global technology leaders.
  • Receive nursery reimbursement benefits.
  • Participate in virtual and onsite international technology conferences.
  • Work within an IT environment aligned with rigorous security and compliance standards, including ISO and SOC frameworks.

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They're among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Supervisor (a) de Manutenção (Florestal)
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar as atividades operacionais de manutenção mecânica.
  • Supervisionar as atividades operacionais de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, abastecimento e lubrificação.
  • Definir a priorização na execução das atividades, assegurando a continuidade operacional.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das periodicidades e das instruções operacionais.
  • Gerenciar informações de produção diária, consumo de materiais, combustíveis, dos equipamentos e mão de obra.
  • Realizar, de forma esporádica, o carregamento e/ou descarregamento das máquinas em veículos de transporte.
  • Analisar indicadores e apoiar na gestão de custos e elaboração do plano operativo. Supervisionar contratos de prestação de serviço.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino técnico completo ou superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Gestão da Manutenção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em atividades de manutenção de máquinas e equipamentos florestais.
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em planejamento e controle de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva.
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho de manutenção.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.
  • CNH categoria B.

title: Oficial de Manutenção Predial

title: Gerente de Manutenção e Ferramental
description:
Gerenciar e otimizar as atividades de manutenção e ferramental com foco em sólidos farmacêuticos, garantindo confiabilidade dos equipamentos, disponibilidade industrial, conformidade regulatória e suporte contínuo à produção.

Você será responsável por liderar a estratégia de manutenção (preventiva, preditiva e corretiva), atuar na melhoria de indicadores (OEE, MTBF/MTTR, disponibilidade e custo) e assegurar que o ferramental esteja sempre apto para operar dentro dos requisitos de BPF e de auditorias.

  • Gerenciar o planejamento e a execução da manutenção de equipamentos e utilidades críticos do processo de sólidos (ex.: granulação, compressão, revestimento, embalagem e sistemas associados).
  • Definir e sustentar a estratégia de manutenção preventiva e preditiva, estabelecendo rotinas, padrões e critérios de intervenção.
  • Atuar na liderança de planos de melhoria contínua para redução de quebras, perdas e paradas não programadas, acompanhando indicadores como MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade e custos.
  • Garantir gestão eficaz do ferramental (revisões, calibração/verificações aplicáveis, vida útil, rastreabilidade e controle de alterações), assegurando conformidade para produção e trocas.
  • Gerenciar gestão de sobressalentes e criticidade de ativos, garantindo níveis adequados de estoque e resposta rápida a falhas.
  • Conduzir e/ ou apoiar investigações de falhas e desvios (CAPA), com foco em causa raiz e prevenção de recorrência.
  • Assegurar conformidade com BPF, procedimentos internos, gestão documental e prontidão para auditorias.
  • Liderar equipe e interfaces (produção, qualidade, engenharia, fornecedores e manutenção terceirizada quando aplicável), promovendo cultura de segurança e disciplina operacional.
  • Elaborar e controlar orçamento de manutenção, projetos de melhoria e contratos de serviços, garantindo execução com qualidade e previsibilidade.
  • Formação superior completa (Engenharias, Administração, áreas correlatas) e experiência comprovada em manutenção industrial.
  • Experiência em ambiente farmacêutico, com atuação específica em sólidos (processos e/ou equipamentos típicos de comprimidos/cápsulas).
  • Conhecimento sólido de estratégias de manutenção: TPM, manutenção preventiva, preditiva, planos de inspeção e gestão de ativos.
  • Vivência com BPF, documentação GMP, gestão de desvios e interface com Qualidade (CAPA, investigação de falhas).
  • Capacidade de liderar equipes e projetos, com foco em indicadores e melhoria contínua (ex.: 5 porquês, Ishikawa, PDCA, RCM/criticidade quando aplicável).
  • Experiência com gestão de ferramental e/ou controle de mudanças (rastreabilidade, revisão/uso, padronização e conformidade para produção).
  • Conhecimento prático de confiabilidade e análise de causa raiz (ex.: análise de falhas, MTBF/MTTR, acompanhamento de tendências).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos/escala conforme necessidade da planta (quando aplicável).
  • Foco industrial: garantia de disponibilidade e desempenho dos ativos e do ferramental para sustentação do processo de sólidos farmacêuticos.
  • Cultura de conformidade: atuação alinhada a práticas BPF e prontidão para auditorias.
  • Melhoria contínua: ambiente voltado a reduzir paradas, aumentar confiabilidade e otimizar custos de manutenção.
  • Interface com áreas-chave: trabalho conjunto com Produção, Qualidade, Engenharia e fornecedores.

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Analista De Garantia Da Qualidade e Excelência Operacional (Industrial)

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

title: Head of Risk, Brazil
description:
Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to

lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the

primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring

our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.

About the Role

As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk

management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and

other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties

  • Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.

Operational cum Technology Risk Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management.
  • Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management
  • Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience.
  • Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security
  • frameworks.
  • Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments.
  • Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers.
  • Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.

Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)

Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).
  • Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.
  • Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.
  • Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).
  • Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).
  • Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.
  • Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies.
  • Professional certifications in risk management (e.g., FRM, CRM) a plus.
  • Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.

P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Accounting Lead
description:
Position Purpose

To lead and oversee the Accounting, Fiscal (Tax), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury functions. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational and reporting excellence across all financial processes. This leader must act as a strategic business consultant, ensuring strategic alignment and supporting decision-making across the entire company.

The owner of the role is also responsible for the fulfillment of both the Grünenthal and local Codes of Conduct in the activities organized by him/her, as well as in those in which he/she participates.

Key Responsibilities

Fiscal, Tax Governance, and Credits

  • Lead the tax credit strategy, actively seeking efficient and additional tax optimization opportunities, in full compliance and alignment with corporate governance.
  • Lead the entire implementation and update of the Brazilian Tax Reform, analyzing its impacts and ensuring business continuity and compliance.
  • Manage the relationship and deliverables of external consultants (Tax).
  • Lead compliance processes with external audit firms (Big Four).
  • Ensure full operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.
  • Search for efficient tax strategies, according to corporate guidance.

Accounting, Audit, and Treasury Management

  • Oversee all Accounting (IFRS/CPCs/German GAAP), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury routines.
  • Lead and coordinate all external (Big Four) and internal audit processes, ensuring deadlines are met and recommendations are correctly implemented.
  • Ensure the accuracy and correct recording of all financial transactions.
  • Lead initiatives to optimize working capital.
  • Lead Continuous Process Improvement initiatives.
  • Manage the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and execution of activities performed by the Shared Service Center (SSC) in Lisbon, Portugal.
  • Coordinate accounting, tax, and treasury projects and ensure their implementation according to corporate requirements.
  • Identify and establish effective procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure proper reporting to governmental entities in accordance with local legislation.
  • Manage the Other Operating Results Budget.
  • Prepare and monitor Cash Flow.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.

Capability Requirements

Mandatory

  • University Degree in Accounting.
  • Active CRC (CPA equivalent).
  • Solid experience in Accounting and Tax Management.
  • Experience working with a Shared Service Center (SSC).
  • Experience reviewing Financial Statements.
  • Experience reviewing ECD and ECF filings.

Desirable

  • MBA or Postgraduate Degree in Finance or Controlling.

Interfaces

  • All business areas, with particular interaction with:
  • Sales

  • Legal
  • Finance Teams

External

  • Big Four Auditors
  • Tax and Accounting Consultants

  • Tax Authorities (RFB and others)
  • Fiscal and Accounting BPO Providers

title: Analista Fiscal Sênior (Impostos Diretos e Indiretos)
description:
China Mobile International Brazil is seeking a Tax Executive to join our growing team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and supporting the company's tax activities, ensuring accurate tax calculations, compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, timely submission of tax obligations, and proper management of tax-related documentation and processes.

The Tax professional will work closely with internal departments, external accounting firms, clients, vendors, and government authorities to ensure tax compliance, support business operations, and identify solutions to tax-related matters.

Work Location: Paulista Area, São Paulo

Work Model: 100% On-site

Job Responsibilities

  • Perform tax calculations and verify assessed taxes, including ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL, IRPJ, CSLL, FUST, FUNTTEL, and withholding taxes, requesting corrections whenever necessary.
  • Prepare and submit ancillary tax obligations, such as GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, DIRF, among others.
  • Collaborate with external accounting firms throughout the tax assessment process by providing accurate and timely information and documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits by gathering, reviewing, and providing all required documentation and information.
  • Keep tax clearance certificates up to date to support participation in public tenders and ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements.
  • Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications.
  • Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team.
  • Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information.
  • Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.
  • Provide tax support to other departments by addressing and clarifying tax-related questions from employees, vendors, and clients.
  • Participate in internal projects by providing tax guidance and proposing solutions to ensure tax compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.
  • Coordinate the tax and fiscal procedures related to the nationalization of imported services and products, ensuring compliance with applicable Brazilian tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company.
  • Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes.
  • Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF.
  • Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices.
  • Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company's operations.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

  • Position offered shall be determined by the candidate's years of relevant experience and skillsets.
  • All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Esta oportunidade também é extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD).

Na Midea, acreditamos que inovação, excelência operacional e desenvolvimento contínuo caminham lado a lado com o cuidado com as pessoas. Somos uma empresa global, referência em tecnologia e soluções para o dia a dia, e seguimos construindo um ambiente cada vez mais colaborativo, seguro e orientado à melhoria contínua.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Supply Chain para integrar nosso time e contribuir diretamente para a eficiência, qualidade e evolução dos nossos processos.

Objetivo Principal:

Garantir o abastecimento de componentes e materiais produtivos para a fabricação de refrigeradores, atuando no desenvolvimento de fornecedores, análise de custos, negociação comercial e suporte às estratégias de redução de custos e continuidade do fornecimento.

Principais Atividades:

  • Apoiar os processos de compras de componentes para refrigeradores e materiais produtivos.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar fornecedores, acompanhando tendências de mercado e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Analisar cotações, realizar comparativos de custos e apoiar negociações comerciais.
  • Monitorar pedidos de compra, cronogramas de entrega e tratativas relacionadas ao fornecimento.
  • Apoiar a homologação de novos fornecedores, validação de amostras e acompanhamento da produção em massa.
  • Elaborar relatórios e análises de compras, contribuindo para projetos de redução de custos e aumento de competitividade.

Escopo de Atuação:

  • Componentes para refrigeradores.
  • Peças plásticas, metálicas e materiais de embalagem.
  • Materiais relacionados ao processo de espumação (Polyol, MDI e correlatos).
  • Demais materiais produtivos relacionados ao processo de fabricação.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em processos de compras, suprimentos ou desenvolvimento de fornecedores.
  • Habilidade para análise de custos, cotações e negociações.
  • Conhecimento em processos produtivos industriais será considerado diferencial.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Product Owner II
description:
Sobre a Trillia:

Agora, DataStock, Neoway, Neurotech e PDtec caminham juntas como Trillia, uma empresa B3.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia orientada por dados, que integra conhecimento, inteligência artificial e inovação aplicada aos negócios.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Produtos II, integrando uma área estratégica responsável pela gestão e evolução dos produtos regulados do mercado segurador. A posição terá papel fundamental na tradução de requisitos regulatórios em soluções de negócio, garantindo aderência às normas, competitividade dos produtos e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.

Essa pessoa será protagonista na condução de iniciativas relacionadas a projetos regulatórios e ao ecossistema de seguros, com forte interação entre áreas de Produto, Tecnologia, Jurídico e Operações. Sua atuação terá impacto direto na evolução do portfólio, no atendimento às exigências regulatórias e na sustentação de projetos estratégicos, como Open Insurance.

Buscamos um perfil analítico, organizado, com excelente capacidade de comunicação e influência, que tenha facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente e construir relacionamentos com diferentes stakeholders.

Se você gosta de desafios, inovação e de atuar em temas com grande relevância para o mercado, essa oportunidade é para você!

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência no mercado de seguros, previdência e capitalização;
  • Vivência com condução e gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de stakeholders e parceiros;
  • Experiência na interação com áreas multidisciplinares, como Tecnologia, Projetos, Operações e Atendimento;
  • Conhecimento em interpretação de normas e tradução de requisitos regulatórios em demandas de negócio;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de organização e gestão, como Jira e Confluence;
  • Perfil dinâmico, autônomo e com visão estratégica;
  • Habilidade de comunicação, negociação e articulação entre diferentes áreas;
  • Conhecimento desejável em projetos regulatórios de Open Insurance e/ou Open Finance;
  • Conhecimento desejável da regulação RC12 (Bacen/Susep);
  • Entendimento básico de resseguro e cosseguro;
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Direito, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Seu papel na Trillia:

No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Gerir projetos regulatórios e toda a cadeia envolvida, desde a geração de cards até acompanhamento de desenvolvimento e testes funcionais;
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em demandas claras para times de desenvolvimento e áreas internas;
  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre áreas técnicas, jurídicas, produtos e tecnologia;
  • Monitorar tendências, mudanças regulatórias e seus impactos nos produtos e no negócio;
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos voltados à evolução de produtos e regulamentação do mercado;
  • Gerir o cronograma e acompanhar as entregas relacionadas ao produto Open Insurance;
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre compliance regulatório, inovação e competitividade dos produtos;
  • Acompanhar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo integração e alinhamento entre as frentes de atuação.

Por que trabalhar na Trillia?

Oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios, pensado para promover bem-estar, desenvolvimento profissional, equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e trabalho e segurança.

Entre eles:

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Benefícios de Alimentação e Refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Modelo de Trabalho Flexível;
  • Programas de Saúde, Bem-estar e Qualidade de vida;
  • Incentivos à educação e desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Benefícios voltados à família e à parentalidade;
  • Seguro de vida e acesso a parcerias e programas corporativos.

Na Trillia, você encontra um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e orientado a dados, onde profissionais têm autonomia, voz e espaço para evoluir.

title: Técnico ambiental
description:

title: Analista Fiscal/Contábil
description:
VAGA | ANALISTA FISCAL E CONTÁBIL

Procuramos alguém que tenha:

  • Experiência em escritório de contabilidade;
  • Conhecimento das rotinas fiscais e/ou contábeis;
  • Conhecimento em empresas do Simples Nacional e Lucro Presumido;
  • Boa capacidade de análise e conferência;
  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos;
  • Atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com sistemas e ferramentas digitais;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com clientes e com a equipe;
  • Interesse em aprender e se desenvolver profissionalmente.

Será um diferencial

  • Experiência com empresas da área da saúde, arquitetura ou construção civil;
  • Conhecimento em retenções tributárias;

A Flexy está vivendo um momento de crescimento e queremos trazer para a equipe pessoas que também estejam buscando evoluir profissionalmente.

Aqui, você terá contato com clientes de diferentes segmentos, poderá ampliar seus conhecimentos técnicos e participar ativamente das rotinas e do desenvolvimento do escritório.

Buscamos construir uma equipe próxima, colaborativa e comprometida com a qualidade do trabalho entregue aos nossos clientes.

Se você procura uma oportunidade para aprender, assumir responsabilidades, desenvolver sua carreira e crescer junto com um escritório que está em expansão, queremos conhecer você.

title: Remote Privacy Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies.
  • Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents.
  • Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes.
  • International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows.
  • Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR.
  • A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil, que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

title: Coordenador(a) de Qualidade
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um profissional de Qualidade em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta vaga é para você.

Você será responsável por coordenar as atividades do time de Qualidade com responsabilidade pela gestão das pessoas, interfaces e qualidade das soluções técnicas.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Coordenar as atividades do Departamento da Qualidade, garantindo o atendimento aos requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001) e demais normas aplicáveis;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a equipe da Qualidade, distribuindo atividades, definindo prioridades e monitorando desempenho;
  • Gerenciar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs), analisando tendências e propondo planos de melhoria contínua;
  • Coordenar auditorias internas, externas e de clientes, incluindo auditorias de organismos certificadores e clientes estratégicos;
  • Atuar como responsável pela manutenção do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, assegurando a atualização de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e registros;
  • Gerenciar o tratamento de Não Conformidades (internas, clientes e fornecedores), conduzindo análise de causa raiz, definição de ações corretivas e verificação de eficácia;
  • Coordenar o processo de homologação, avaliação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação;
  • Suportar processos de certificação e manutenção de certificados de produtos, acompanhando ensaios laboratoriais e documentação técnica junto aos órgãos certificadores;
  • Garantir a conformidade dos produtos com requisitos normativos, regulatórios e especificações de clientes;
  • Elaboração de Data Book – Petrobras;
  • Gerenciar processos de calibração de equipamentos de medição e monitoramento, garantindo rastreabilidade metrológica;
  • Coordenar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, assegurando o cumprimento dos critérios de aceitação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com Engenharia, Produção, Supply Chain e Atendimento ao Cliente na resolução de problemas de qualidade;
  • Suportar projetos de melhoria contínua utilizando ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e Lean Six Sigma;
  • Elaborar apresentações gerenciais, reportando indicadores, riscos e planos de ação à liderança.

Quem você é:

Você apresenta elevado nível de atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade, assegurando aderência rigorosa às diretrizes, instruções e padrões de processo estabelecidos pela organização. Combinando pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes, transmitindo mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa.. Você prevê conflitos antes que eles aconteçam, com base no conhecimento da dinâmica interpessoal e de grupo. A função exige, ainda, disciplina operacional, responsabilidade e zelo constante pelas pessoas, organização, segurança e ambiente de trabalho.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Qualidade, Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência com qualificação de fornecedores e auditorias de qualidade;
  • Inglês avançado (para contato com fornecedores internacionais);
  • Conhecimento da ISO 9001;
  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes na área de Qualidade e laboratório de Qualidade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas;
  • Local de trabalho: Barueri, SP.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão / Engenharia da Qualidade e Certificações relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e 6-Sigma;
  • Conhecimento em ERP Omega da ABC71
  • Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas
  • Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:
About iQIYI

iQIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.

Role purpose

Support iQIYI's expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.

Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.

Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.

Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

description:

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project "Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006."

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal's geopolitical offer.

The contract will require the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific. The intended start date is January 2027, with an implementation period of 48 months.

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Aviation Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the aviation sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of aviation infrastructure and air transport projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting airport master planning, infrastructure development and air connectivity planning.
  • Advising on airport infrastructure, airport systems, air transport services and operational efficiency.
  • Supporting aviation safety, security and compliance with relevant international and European standards and good practices.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, and operation and maintenance planning for aviation infrastructure.
  • Promoting sustainable and low-carbon aviation, including measures to improve energy efficiency and reduce the environmental footprint of airport operations.
  • Integrating climate resilience, disaster risk reduction and environmental and social considerations into aviation infrastructure planning and investment.
  • Supporting policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the aviation sector.
  • Contributing to the assessment and improvement of investment climates and regulatory frameworks for aviation infrastructure and services.
  • Providing capacity building and technical assistance to civil aviation authorities, airport operators, public institutions and other sector stakeholders.
  • Coordinating with public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.
  • Supporting the promotion and adoption of European standards and good practices in partner countries.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Master's degree or equivalent diploma in aeronautical engineering, airport engineering, civil engineering, transport engineering, aviation management, or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the aviation sector, including airports, air transport, aviation safety, air connectivity and sustainability aspects, as well as related policies and international good practices.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the aviation sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, civil aviation authorities, airport operators, airlines, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of aviation infrastructure and services investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to aviation infrastructure and services delivery, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, climate resilience and sustainability considerations.

Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of aviation infrastructure, airport systems and/or air transport services.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in aviation projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America or Asia.
  • Professional experience related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure Investment in the aviation sector, in particular on the technical side, such as feasibility studies, project design, airport planning, aviation safety, social and environmental issues, maintenance, procurement, connectivity, operational efficiency and resilience, etc.

Assets

  • Professional experience in the Sub-Saharan Africa region (in situ).
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the aviation sector.
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Estagiário(a) de Social Media & Conteúdo Digital
description:
Estagiário(a) de Marketing e Conteúdo – Brasília

O Cassel Ruzzarin Advogados, escritório com atuação nacional e forte presença na advocacia estratégica, está em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Marketing e Conteúdo para integrar nossa equipe em Brasília.

Buscamos um estudante com bom repertório de comunicação digital, criatividade, iniciativa e vontade de produzir, que queira desenvolver experiência prática em marketing aplicado a um ambiente profissional de alta exigência.

A posição terá participação direta na produção de conteúdo, criação visual, edição de vídeos, cobertura de eventos e gestão de redes sociais, em contato próximo com a equipe de Marketing e com os profissionais do escritório.

Área de Atuação

  • Marketing e comunicação institucional
  • Conteúdo para redes sociais
  • Produção audiovisual
  • Design e criação digital
  • Comunicação de marca

Principais Atividades

  • Criação e adaptação de cards, peças gráficas e outros conteúdos para redes sociais
  • Edição de vídeos curtos, Reels, Shorts e conteúdos institucionais
  • Captação de fotos e vídeos em eventos, reuniões, palestras e atividades do escritório
  • Apoio em filmagens, considerando enquadramento, iluminação, captação de áudio e composição visual
  • Programação e publicação de conteúdos em redes sociais
  • Apoio à gestão dos perfis do escritório, especialmente Instagram e LinkedIn
  • Produção e revisão de textos, legendas e conteúdos digitais
  • Organização de imagens, vídeos e demais materiais produzidos pela equipe
  • Acompanhamento de métricas e desempenho das publicações
  • Apoio em campanhas digitais e iniciativas de marketing institucional

Requisitos

  • Estar cursando, a partir do 6o semestre, graduação em:
  • Publicidade e Propaganda
  • Marketing
  • Comunicação Social
  • Audiovisual
  • Cinema
  • Design
  • ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento razoável de Canva e ferramentas de criação visual
  • Conhecimento de edição de vídeo, utilizando CapCut, Premiere ou ferramenta similar
  • Familiaridade com Instagram, LinkedIn e formatos de conteúdo para redes sociais
  • Noções de fotografia e captação de vídeo
  • Conhecimentos básicos de filmagem, enquadramento, iluminação e áudio
  • Boa capacidade de redação e comunicação
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa aplicadas à produção de conteúdo e ao marketing

Competências Essenciais

  • Criatividade e bom senso estético
  • Capacidade de transformar ideias em conteúdo
  • Boa comunicação escrita
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Iniciativa e autonomia
  • Curiosidade e disposição para aprender
  • Responsabilidade com prazos e entregas
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe

Diferencial Estratégico

Valorizamos candidatos que saibam utilizar Inteligência Artificial Generativa como ferramenta de apoio à criatividade e à produtividade, especialmente para:

  • desenvolvimento e refinamento de ideias
  • pesquisa e organização de referências
  • apoio à produção de textos e roteiros
  • criação de conceitos para conteúdos e campanhas
  • ganho de eficiência no processo de produção

Conhecimentos adicionais em Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects, Figma, fotografia ou motion design serão considerados diferenciais.

Portfólio

Será considerado um diferencial relevante possuir portfólio com trabalhos acadêmicos, pessoais ou profissionais.

Não é necessário ter experiência formal anterior, mas esperamos que o candidato consiga demonstrar, por meio de seus trabalhos, repertório visual, criatividade e capacidade de execução.

O que você encontrará aqui

  • Participação direta na produção de conteúdo de uma marca profissional com atuação nacional
  • Contato com projetos de marketing institucional, conteúdo, audiovisual e eventos
  • Ambiente profissional estruturado e de alta exigência
  • Aprendizado prático com uma equipe de Marketing em atividade permanente
  • Espaço para desenvolver ideias e assumir responsabilidades progressivamente
  • Experiência em comunicação aplicada ao mercado jurídico e institucional
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional
  • Possibilidade de efetivação

Informações da Vaga

Local: Brasília/DF

Modalidade: Híbrida

Jornada: 6 horas diárias – 30 horas semanais

Bolsa-auxílio: R$ 2.250,00

Benefício: Auxílio-transporte nos dias de trabalho presencial

Início: imediato

Para se candidatar

Currículo e, se possível, portfólio ou links para trabalhos realizados.

Podem ser apresentados projetos acadêmicos, perfis de redes sociais, vídeos, fotografias, peças gráficas ou outros trabalhos que ajudem a demonstrar suas habilidades.

title: Encarregado(a) Administrativo
description:
Buscamos um(a) Encarregado(a) Administrativo para liderar a equipe administrativa da unidade, assegurando a excelência nos processos financeiros, atendimento aos cooperados, controles operacionais e gestão de pessoas na Cocari.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar, orientar e motivar a equipe administrativa da unidade;
  • Realizar avaliações de desempenho, feedbacks e treinamentos internos para aprimoramento da equipe;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas para acompanhamento de metas e melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Gerenciar controles de estoque de grãos, acompanhando movimentações via sistema e planilhas;
  • Garantir a excelência no atendimento aos cooperados e administração de suas carteiras;
  • Coordenar processos de contas a receber, análise de crédito, pareceres de débitos vencidos e controle de inadimplência;
  • Realizar e analisar a comercialização e fixação de grãos, além do processo de restituição de ICMS;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das rotinas trabalhistas (ponto, férias, benefícios) e gestão de contratos com fornecedores;
  • Gerenciar equipes de conservação predial, portaria, refeitório e serviços terceirizados;
  • Supervisionar as condições de segurança do trabalho e promover o bem-estar da equipe junto ao SESMT.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Técnico ou Superior em Administração, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão Empresarial, Ciências Contábeis ou Economia;
  • Experiência sólida de 4 anos na área administrativa e financeira;
  • Conhecimento em liderança, gestão de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Experiência com análise de crédito, controles financeiros e gerenciamento de carteira;
  • Vivência no segmento de agronegócios e cooperativismo;
  • Conhecimento dos produtos agrícolas (soja, milho, trigo e café);
  • Conhecimento das normas de Saúde, Segurança e Medicina do Trabalho.

Benefícios

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênios e benefícios internos;
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.

Na Cocari, acreditamos que uma gestão administrativa eficiente fortalece a cooperação e gera resultados sustentáveis. Se você busca desafios e deseja fazer parte desta trajetória, esperamos sua candidatura!

title: Gerente de negócios
description:

O QUE BUSCAMOS:

title: Overseas Pre-sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility:

Solution Development and Customization:

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development:

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.

Requirement:

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

title: Consultor de negócios
description:

Salário + Variável + Benefícios

Aqui você terá autonomia, desafios estratégicos e a oportunidade de atuar diretamente no crescimento do negócio.
